name: Smooth & Shine Okra Shampoo
description: An intensively nourishing botanical shampoo infused with pure Okra fruit mucilage extract. Packed with natural amino acids, vitamins A and C, and essential minerals, this gentle sulfate-free cleanser restores hydration to brittle strands, tames stubborn frizz, and leaves hair visibly glossy and full of life.
benefits: Natural mucilage creates a silky slip that detangles without weight
Controls humidity-induced frizz and seals hair cuticles
Fortified with Biotin and Pro-Vitamin B5 for scalp resilience
Color-safe, sulfate-free, silicone-free, and 100% vegan
ingredients: Aqua (Purified Water), Abelmoschus Esculentus (Okra) Fruit Extract, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Aloe Barbadensis (Aloe Vera) Leaf Juice, Biotin, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein, Argania Spinosa (Argan) Kernel Oil, Panthenol, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Extract, Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Natural Essential Oil Blend, Citric Acid, Potassium Sorbate.
howToUse: Apply generously to thoroughly soaked hair. Massage gently onto your scalp using your fingertips, creating a luxurious creamy lather. Glide through lengths to ends. Rinse thoroughly with cool to lukewarm water. Follow with Okra Deep Moisture Conditioner for optimal shine.

name: Gentle Foaming Okra Face Wash
description: A cloud-soft daily foaming facial cleanser powered by antioxidant-rich Okra extract and Green Tea. Dissolves pollutants, sunscreen, and excess sebum while protecting your moisture barrier with natural polysaccharides.
benefits: Leaves skin feeling hydrated and plump, never stripped or dry
Rich in natural Vitamin C and flavonoids to promote clarity
Calms redness and balances sensitive or combination skin
Soap-free, fragrance-free, and dermatologically tested
ingredients: Aqua, Abelmoschus Esculentus (Okra) Fruit Extract, Glycerin, Camellia Sinensis (Green Tea) Leaf Water, Decyl Glucoside, Sodium Hyaluronate, Centella Asiatica Extract, Allantoin, Citric Acid, Phenoxyethanol.
howToUse: Pump 1-2 puffs onto damp palms. Gently massage in circular motions across face and neck for 60 seconds. Rinse with lukewarm water and pat dry.

name: Okra Glow Serum (Niacinamide + Vit C)
description: An ultra-concentrated elixir combining cold-extracted Okra mucilage with 5% Niacinamide and 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C). Penetrates deeply to brighten dark spots, tighten enlarged pores, and impart a glass-skin glow.
benefits: Noticeably illuminates dull, tired skin within 14 days
Okra peptides boost collagen synthesis and elasticity
Strengthens the lipid barrier against environmental stress
Fast-absorbing silky texture with zero tacky residue
ingredients: Abelmoschus Esculentus (Okra) Extract (72%), Niacinamide (5%), 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (3%), Sodium Hyaluronate, Polyglutamic Acid, Ferulic Acid, Licorice Root Extract, Ethylhexylglycerin.
howToUse: Dispense 3-4 drops directly onto cleansed skin morning and evening. Pat gently with fingertips until fully absorbed. Follow with moisturizer and daytime SPF.

name: Deep Moisture Okra Hair Mask
description: A buttery botanical conditioning mask designed for dry, heat-damaged, or over-processed hair. High-viscosity okra extract wraps each hair fiber in protective hydration.
benefits: Reconstructs broken hair bonds and seals split ends
Delivers 72-hour humidity protection and mirrors shine
Restores elasticity to curly, coily, and wavy patterns
ingredients: Aqua, Abelmoschus Esculentus (Okra) Fruit Extract, Cetearyl Alcohol, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, Hydrolyzed Keratin, Behentrimonium Methosulfate, Citric Acid.
howToUse: After shampooing, apply an ample scoop from mid-lengths to ends. Detangle with a wide-tooth comb. Leave in for 10-15 minutes, then rinse with cold water.

name: Silky Botanical Okra Body Lotion
description: Velvety all-over body hydrator formulated with Okra mucilage, Shea Butter, and Squalane. Drenches dry skin with non-greasy 24-hour hydration.
benefits: Instantly relieves rough elbows, knees, and dry patches
Locks in moisture after shower without greasy film
Delicate natural botanical aroma of eucalyptus and green fig
ingredients: Aqua, Abelmoschus Esculentus (Okra) Fruit Extract, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Shea Butter, Olive Squalane, Glyceryl Stearate, Jojoba Seed Oil, Xanthan Gum.
howToUse: Smooth generously all over the body, ideally right after showering while skin is slightly damp.

name: Revitalizing Okra & Rosemary Scalp Oil
description: A multi-target scalp treatment combining nutrient-dense cold-pressed Okra seed oil with pure Rosemary leaf oil to stimulate microcirculation and fortify roots.
benefits: Soothes itchy, flaky scalp conditions
Supports healthy follicle growth and strand thickness
Lightweight formula washes out cleanly with shampoo
ingredients: Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Abelmoschus Esculentus (Okra) Seed Oil, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Oil, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Peppermint Oil.
howToUse: Part hair into sections. Apply a few drops directly to scalp and massage for 5 minutes. Leave on for 30 minutes or overnight before washing.
